name: Layered Cheese Ball
description: A visually appealing layered cheese ball made with cream cheese, pineapple, cherries, and pecans.
recipeIngredient: 1/3 cup chopped maraschino cherries with some juice
1/3 cup crushed pineapple with some juice

recipeInstructions.text: Line a loaf pan with Saran Wrap.
Mix each package of cream cheese with a different ingredient: crushed pineapple, maraschino cherries, and mayonnaise with pecans.
Layer each mixture in the loaf pan, starting with pineapple, then cherries, and finally mayonnaise with pecans.
Chill overnight.
Turn out onto a platter and garnish with cut vegetables or cherries and chives or parsley.
Serve with assorted crackers.

keywords: layered cheese ball, party appetizer, elegant snack

_similar.name: Cheese Ball
_similar.description: A classic cheese ball made with grated cheese, Cheez Whiz, and deviled ham, perfect for a quick appetizer.
recipeIngredient: Chopped pecans or parsley flakes for coating

recipeInstructions.text: Beat all ingredients in a mixer until creamed.
Form into 2 balls and wrap in Saran Wrap.
Refrigerate until firm.
Roll into chopped pecans or parsley flakes to coat.

_similar.keywords: cheese ball, party appetizer, easy snack

_similar.name: Fruit Dip
_similar.description: A simple and flavorful cream cheese dip infused with orange juice and marshmallow creme, ideal for fresh fruit.

recipeInstructions.text: Combine all ingredients in a dish and beat until smooth and well blended.
Serve immediately with fresh cut-up fruit.

_similar.keywords: fruit dip, orange cream cheese, marshmallow dip

_similar.name: Cottage Cheese Jellied Salad
_similar.description: A light and fruity salad made with cottage cheese, pineapple, and walnuts, set in a gelatin mold.
recipeIngredient: 3 oz package orange or lemon flavored gelatin

recipeInstructions.text: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water.
Add mayonnaise and whisk to blend.
Chill until the mixture starts to set.
Add cottage cheese, pineapple, and walnuts. Combine well.
Pour the mixture into a clear glass bowl or a 4-cup lightly oiled mold.

_similar.keywords: cottage cheese salad, jellied salad, pineapple salad

_similar.name: Orange-Pineapple Jello
_similar.description: A fruity Jello dessert with orange, pineapple, and nuts.
recipeIngredient: ½ cup frozen orange juice concentrate

recipeInstructions.text: Drain pineapple and reserve syrup. Add water to make ¾ cup.
Heat the liquid to boiling.
Place Jello in a bowl and add hot liquid, pineapple, and orange juice concentrate.
Chill until thickish.
Fold in Dream Whip along with marshmallows and pecans.

_similar.name: Party Salmon Ball
_similar.description: A classic chilled salmon and cream cheese ball coated in crunchy nuts and parsley.
recipeIngredient: 1 (16 oz) can salmon, drained and flaked

recipeInstructions.text: Mix all ingredients together except for the nuts and parsley.
Shape the mixture into a ball.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 8 hours (but no longer than 4 days).
Roll the ball in a mixture of nuts and parsley to coat evenly before serving.

_similar.keywords: salmon ball, cheese ball, party dip, holiday appetizer
